package.name: vlp16_config
package.description: VLP-16 hardware configuration over the sensor's own embedded web/CGI API (motor RPM, return type, field of view, network settings) -- separate from velodyne_driver_node, which only reads UDP packets the sensor is already broadcasting and never talks to this HTTP interface. Also owns velodyne_transform_node's per-scan capture-window parameters (min/max range, view direction/width), pushing and persisting them on this node's behalf since that node has no settings-persistence hook of its own.
